title: Thanksgiving Day Rollover Forces Road Closure on Mann Road in Laredo
excerpt: A single-vehicle rollover in the early hours of Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, closed Mann Road near the entrance to the JSJ area in Laredo. First responders are on the scene.
content:
A single-vehicle rollover in the early hours of Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, has closed Mann Road near the entrance to the JSJ area in Laredo.

An ambulance and emergency first responders are at the scene. Motorists are advised to avoid the area and seek alternate routes while emergency personnel respond.

Update — Nov. 27, 2026: Laredo police now say three passengers were taken to the hospital after the crash, one of them in critical condition. The crash happened at about 12:30 a.m. Thursday at Springfield and Mann Road, and the vehicle was a black Ford Explorer, according to KGNS. Witnesses, including a federal agent who was waiting at a red light, said the Explorer was traveling at a high rate of speed. The department's Crash Team is investigating.

This is a developing story. Webb Watch 956 will update this report as more information is confirmed.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 26–27, 2026; Laredo Police Department.
